headline: Economy/Labor: Wages of construction and industry workers are the most protected against inflation
summary: Almost six in ten industrial workers and nine in ten construction workers have wage guarantee clauses that protect pay against inflation, according to the report.
why: Indexation clauses in collective wage agreements influence labour costs and how inflation passes through to company margins.
